name: Nakano-Sakaue
tagline: Shinjuku in 4 minutes and Shibuya in 14 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Nakano City, where Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 24 minutes to Otemachi, 4 minutes to Shinjuku, 14 minutes to Shibuya and 35 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 33.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 33.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.9 m to 34.8 m, a difference of 10.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 5 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: マルマンストア 中野店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 16 clinics and 13 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 仁友会国際仁友病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 圭友会小原病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line run through it. Toei Oedo Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is not on. Toei Oedo Line runs at 147%. Its busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome; for rail connections, Nakano-Sakaue.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nakano-Sakaue. Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome has only the Toei Oedo Line, so Nakano-Sakaue is the better connected. To Otemachi, for instance, Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome takes 3 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥7,000 more at Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome. On quiet, though, Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Nakano-Shimbashi; for rail connections, Nakano-Sakaue.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nakano-Sakaue. Nakano-Shimbashi has only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, so Nakano-Sakaue is the better connected. To Roppongi, for instance, Nakano-Shimbashi takes 28 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Nakano-Shimbashi comes out ahead.

goodFor: People who want a park close by
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
山手通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
